title: Viablife BioNia: 100% bio-based niacinamide for safer, high-performance sustainable beauty
summary: At in-cosmetics Asia 2026 (3–5 November), Viablife BioNia was shortlisted for the IN-COSMETICS ASIA AWARDS, one of the leading recognitions at the Asia-Pacific region’s premier personal care ingredients event. As the only Chinese company on this year’s shortlist, Viablife brought its biotechnology-led innovation to the international stage, highlighting the growing potential of bio-based ingredients in cosmetics
